title: Finite compact-U(1) equation-level invariance and Gauss-flow consistency audit
question: Do the displayed finite M3 compact-U(1) equations have the declared local gauge-charge cancellations, a neutral Gauss constraint, a finite coercivity identity, and a consistent gauge-invariant observable map, without admitting a source owner or physical model?
purpose: Add a bounded equation-level audit to the already recorded M3 design candidate. This is a consistency check of the displayed finite contract only; it does not admit the candidate, select a dynamics, or modify the established T-054 forward or T-059/T-061 inverse methods.

finite_scope.lattice: periodic cubic Lambda_L=(Z/LZ)^3 with three oriented link directions
finite_scope.link_group: compact U(1) with endpoint convention U_(x,i)->exp(i lambda_x) U_(x,i) exp(-i lambda_(x+e_i))
finite_scope.matter: complex phi_x and pi_x with the declared local phase convention
finite_scope.functional: the finite Hamiltonian and Gauss expression copied by reference from the M3 design manifest
finite_scope.observable_scope: plaquette, covariant density, matter density, current, and Gauss-matter monomials
finite_scope.quantum_status: no Hilbert-space, measure, operator-domain, or QFT statement

audited_identities.plaquette_charge_cancellation: every oriented plaquette product has zero site charge
audited_identities.covariant_difference: the two terms U_(x,i)phi_(x+e_i) and phi_x have the same charge, so |D_i phi|^2 is neutral
audited_identities.observable_neutrality: Wilson/plaquette, |phi|^2, current, and pi^*phi monomials have zero site charge
audited_identities.gauss_surface: the displayed divergence-minus-Im(pi^*phi) constraint is gauge neutral; preservation is recorded conditionally on the declared canonical generator
audited_identities.energy_identity: the canonical antisymmetric Poisson self-bracket {H,H}=0 is an algebraic identity
audited_identities.coercivity: lambda*x^2/4+m^2*x/2 = lambda/4*(x+m^2/lambda)^2-(m^2)^2/(4 lambda) for lambda>0 and x=|phi|^2>=0
audited_identities.finite_flow: the polynomial finite-dimensional Hamiltonian vector field has a conditional global-flow interpretation from the displayed coercive sublevel bound; this is not an owner-admitted dynamics

assumptions: The finite lattice, endpoint convention, plaquette orientation, symplectic convention, Hamiltonian and Gauss expression are exactly those in the parent M3 design manifest.
The charge algebra is used only as a finite bookkeeping representation of the declared U(1) phase action.
lambda>0 and chi,kappa_E,beta,kappa_D>0 are inserted finite parameters; m^2 is real.
The canonical generator premise is conditional when translating neutrality into Gauss-surface preservation.
The audit is equation-level and does not supply a versioned source owner, statistical state, or observation calibration.
missing_assumptions: A versioned authorized source owner and hash-pinned implementation of the candidate flow.
A complete state or ensemble, covariance and numerical/quantum realization.
An explicit physical projection and a common F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map with prospective holdout.
Uniform cutoff, volume and continuum estimates, renormalization and a limit order.
A proof that any winding or flux sector is physical rather than a regulator artefact.
A candidate-neutral dynamic discriminator and comparison against the other Pre-A candidates.

adversarial_review.check: Could an equation audit replace T-054 or T-059/T-061?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the audit is additive and all established methods and owner order remain controlling.

adversarial_review.check: Could compact U(1) charge cancellation be promoted to Yang--Mills identity?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: the Yang--Mills and QFT flags remain false.

adversarial_review.check: Could neutrality alone be reported as an unconditional production-flow theorem?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: Gauss preservation is explicitly conditional on the declared canonical-generator premise and source ownership is missing.

adversarial_review.check: Could the finite completion square be called a continuum stability result?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: all limit and physical flags remain false.

adversarial_review.check: Could a neutral observable definition be called a measured or fitted result?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: F_reg is only a definition; no state, uncertainty, fit or holdout is supplied.

adversarial_review.check: Could R0 be identified with Reading-H physical empty space?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the parent manifest explicitly forbids that identification.

preregistered_falsifiers: Any nonzero site charge in a displayed Hamiltonian or observable term rejects this candidate version's gauge contract.
A mismatch between the two covariant-difference term charges rejects the declared covariant norm.
A failed completion-square identity or nonpositive inserted lambda blocks the finite-flow conditional statement.
Any attempt to set source_owner_admitted, candidate_admitted, continuum_closed or physical_empty_closed true is rejected by the scope firewall.
evidence_level: T0 exact finite equation-level consistency audit; not candidate admission
non_claims: This result does not admit or select PA-M3-COMPACT-U1-HAMILTONIAN-v0.
It does not prove a source-owned dynamics, a quantum representation, a physical gauge theory, Yang--Mills, QFT, gravity or a continuum limit.
It does not evaluate Reading-H stationarity, the physical-empty sign, transverse stability, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6 or a mass gap.
It does not fit observations, produce an uncertainty budget, or provide prospective holdout credit.
The established T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 inverse methods and owner order are unchanged.

lean_crosscheck.role: Lean checks the finite integer charge and rational completion identities; Python checks lattice coverage, all displayed term classes, parameter fixtures, flow boundary and promotion firewalls.

boundary: R-457 is a finite equation-level consistency audit of the displayed M3 design contract. Its charge cancellations and completion-square identity are exact under the inserted finite assumptions; the Gauss-flow statement is conditional on the declared canonical generator. No source owner, state, observation map, candidate admission, physical identity, continuum, QFT, Yang--Mills, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6 or mass-gap conclusion follows.
next_action: Use this audit only as a quality gate for the existing M3 design. Do not score or select it until a versioned source owner, complete state/uncertainty contract, dynamic two-time estimand, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and prospective holdout are supplied. Continue unchanged T-054 Q3LOCK owner intake and T-059/T-061 observation-source intake; do not create a substitute finite mobility table.
